integrity: Analytical theorem supported by independent finite-ring numerical tests, Bessel-integral quadratures, branch-cut quadratures and crossover tests; numerical examples are not substituted for asymptotic proofs. No independent audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact for translation-invariant nearest-neighbor Hamiltonian on the infinite integer line, constant projector site-dephasing rate and independent Poisson resets to the origin. The claimed universal crossover requires fixed nonzero hopping and positive reset rate, dephasing tending to zero and distance diverging with the stated scaled variable. The general reset resolvent and coherent Bessel kernel are preexisting methods; a broader unlocated equivalent result remains possible.
title: Pole–branch crossover in a site-dephased quantum walk with Poisson resetting
